title: The Siphoner's Companion
summary: A companion for those past the primers that teaches the steady siphon on a hostile soul and the veil that swallows part of a blow.

title: A Treatise on the Returned Flame
summary: A treatise on drawing the flame out of a hostile technique and giving it back through the guard of the one who threw it.

title: The Hawk's Gleaning Treatise
summary: Teaches stooping on the richest hostile force in a fight and seizing it in one clean draw to carry back to the reserve.

title: The Basin and River Reclamation
summary: A text on turning a river of hostile force back into a clean basin of the user's own and returning it in a surge.

title: The Wind-Sworn Reckoning of Spent Force
summary: A reckoning for the wind-sworn of the force a battle leaves on the wind and of taking it in and giving it back as a gale.

title: Manual of the Open Sky Cistern
summary: A manual of the cistern that stands open to the air and drinks the force of every technique that passes over it.
